issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按卡片 md 猜成 40f，改版前视频只演到描边一半就结束，闭合闪、交棒、下划线全没出现
左上角打着调试标题 DRAW SVG TRACE，背景是纯色灰底
笔头只是一段更粗的同色线段，读不出'有一支笔在画'
闭合后填进来的是灰色骨架条 + 灰圆头像，交棒的 2px 灰边比墨线还粗糙
内容一次性整体淡入，卡片本身没有任何体积变化
changes: 补导出 DRAW_SVG_TRACE_DURATION = 126：描边 40f → 闪黑交棒 16f → 下划线 18f → 真静止 40f（R1）
去掉调试标题；柔光纸面底 + 暗角 + 颗粒；墨色换成带冷调的 #17181c，闭合仍冲纯黑 + 4→8px 加粗
笔头改为三段渐细 dash（5.2/6.4/7.6px）+ 按圆角矩形弧长参数精确定位的圆形笔尖（带落影与一点高光），起收 2f 淡入淡出
卡片内容换成出版级指标卡：标签 + 'Revenue grew 38% in Q3' 标题 + 正文 + 12 柱趋势图 + 署名行；第二用法改为只给重点词 38% 画下划线
闭合后各元素自上而下 2f 错峰 8f 上浮淡入，卡片阴影随'上色'从贴地长到静置高度；交棒 border 改为 1px 发丝线
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench guessed 40f from the card md; the before video stopped mid-trace, never reaching the close flash, handoff or underline
A debug title DRAW SVG TRACE sat top-left over a flat grey background
The pen tip was just a thicker segment of the same line, not reading as a pen drawing
After closing, the card filled with grey skeleton bars and a grey dot avatar, and the 2px grey handoff border looked cruder than the ink line
Content faded in all at once and the card itself had no sense of volume
changesEn: Exported DRAW_SVG_TRACE_DURATION = 126: 40f trace → 16f flash/handoff → 18f underline → 40f true hold (R1)
Removed the debug title; soft paper backdrop with vignette and grain; ink is a cool #17181c, still flashing to pure black with a 4→8px weight on close
Pen is three tapered dashes (5.2/6.4/7.6px) plus a round nib placed exactly by rounded-rect arc length, with a drop shadow and tiny highlight, fading in/out over 2f
Card content is a publication-grade metric card: label, 'Revenue grew 38% in Q3' headline, body copy, a 12-bar trend and a byline; the second usage now underlines only the key figure 38%
After closing, elements rise and fade in top-down with a 2f stagger over 8f, the card shadow grows from flat to resting height, and the handoff border is a 1px hairline
